name: Telecommunications retail

regulators.name: ACMA
regulators.role: Enforces CCH Standard, FH Standard, CIA Determination, Pre-Porting Standard, TCP Code

scope_notes: Red-team and reference coverage for telco support and sales agents: complaint handling and TIO, financial hardship, identity authentication for high-risk transactions and pre-porting, and responsible selling under the TCP Code.
known_gaps: TCP Code status: the ACMA 27 March 2026 announcement that a TCP industry standard will replace the code was seen only as quoted on the code owner's site; no replacement standard was found on the Federal Register at 2026-10-27. Re-check before relying on TCP clause numbers.
TCP Code clause numbers are not in the PDF text layer; 4.5.2 is inferred from sequence.
Telecommunications (Domestic, Family and Sexual Violence Consumer Protections) Industry Standard 2025 (F2025L00664) is in force and relevant to support agents but was not read or excerpted.
Telecommunications Act 1997 penalty provisions (ss 101, 121, 128, Part 31) were not re-read; enforceability labels rest on the instrument type.
ACL ss 18 and 29 cited by code only; verified by another agent.
Privacy Act 1988 / APPs and the Telecommunications Act Part 13 disclosure rules were deliberately left out (scope).
Corpus entries are research-verified on 2026-10-27 but not signed off by a compliance or legal SME.
